connection: stdlib sqlite3; a fresh connection per helper call
queries: Rates are read via fetch_latest_rate; conversions hit the cache first and only fall back to the table on a miss or expiry
transactions: rate seeding inserts with a single commit each
n_plus_one: No: conversions reuse the cached rate within the TTL window
concurrency: single-process CLI, no shared mutable state beyond the cache

optimization_targets.description: Preserve the TTL cache for exchange rates so repeated conversions of the same pair stay in memory
Keep get_rate cache-first so report generation does not re-query rates per expense row

notes: Monthly reports can contain thousands of expense rows across a handful of currency pairs; the intended optimization is to guarantee at most one lookup per pair per report.
